subject: CAIQ: ownership attestation + SSO/SCIM snapshot for NovaHealth
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@novahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@novahealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ access snapshot + owner attestation request

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — NovaHealth wants to move forward with the SIG/CAIQ review. To close out our vendor review we need a short access snapshot and an attestation of ownership for privileged accounts tied to SSO/SCIM. Specifically can you provide the following by end of day Monday: 

- A CAIQ worksheet (answers) focused on access controls/SSO/SAML/SCIM (we only need the access-related sections)
- A sample SAML assertion for a successful login (no PII, just header/attributes)
- A SCIM delta snapshot demonstrating account provisioning/termination activity for the last 30 days
- Confirmation of the least-privilege process: who is the permission owner roster and the cadence for role recertification

If anything needs an NDAs or secure upload, advise and we will route. Appreciate a single bundle (zip) if possible.

Best,
Alice
Alice Chen
Security Analyst, NovaHealth
alice.chen@novahealth.com
security@novahealth.com

Attachment: (none yet)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@novahealth.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ access snapshot + owner attestation request

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you requested; high-level plan below and an ask for one quick clarification.

Plan (will deliver a single ZIP):
- CAIQ answers (access sections) — XLSX with references to evidence files (will include links)
- SAML assertion sample — redacted text file (no tokens/PII)
- SCIM delta snapshot — CSV export of provisioning events for the last 30 days
- Ownership roster & recert cadence — short PDF (owners, teams, quarterly cadence)

Quick clarification: when you say "permission owner roster" do you want owners at the role level (e.g., admin, editor, viewer) or owner per application/service account? We typically deliver both but can compress if you prefer one.

We will prepare the bundle and upload to a secure Drive link unless you need a different transfer method. Expect the bundle by Mon EOD PST.

Thanks — looping in Sean (Security PM) and Karthik (IAM) so we can assemble audit artifacts quickly.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: action-item checklist (internal)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Alice / NovaHealth team — attaching the bundle per your ask. Files included (zipped):

- caiq_answers_v1.xlsx (tab: AccessControls) — answers with evidence pointers
- saml-assertion-sample.txt — header + attribute list (redacted)
- scim-delta-snapshot-20260821.csv — provisioning/termination rows, timestamps, actor id (redacted)
- owner-roster-quartly-recert.pdf — role owners and recert cadence
- readme.txt — short notes on redactions and where full artifacts are stored (internal)

Attachment stubs:
- caiq_answers_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- saml-assertion-sample.txt (text/plain)
- scim-delta-snapshot-20260821.zip (application/zip)

Key points to call out:
- SCIM deltas are redacted for personal identifiers; we included internal actor ids that map to owners in the roster PDF.
- We have an audit trail (immutable logs) for provisioning events; full logs require an IR access agreement — let us know if you need those.
- Least-privilege process: owners are at the role-and-application level. Owners listed in owner-roster-quartly-recert.pdf; recert is quarterly and run by the Platform Security team (Karthik primary).

If you want a walk-through of the CSV/SAML sample we can schedule 30m next week.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: caiq_answers_v1.xlsx, saml-assertion-sample.txt, scim-delta-snapshot-20260821.zip
